name: Consensus
summary: AI search engine that finds and synthesizes peer-reviewed research and returns cited, evidence-backed answers.
description: Consensus searches 400+ million peer-reviewed papers and returns AI summaries, study metadata and citations; the Consensus Meter aggregates findings across studies for yes/no/possible questions. A web app, REST API and MCP server bring the same search and synthesis to people and agents. Free, Pro, Deep, Teams and Enterprise plans.
